answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, anchoring identity to verifiable capital rather than fluid virtual accounts. Like the shifting sands of a dune, decentralized networks demand stable protocols to prevent identity inflation. Validators must lock native tokens, a process as rigid as cooling basalt, to ensure honest participation. This economic tether creates a crystal clear cost for attackers, who must acquire a majority of the circulating supply to compromise the network consensus.
